description: `PurePosixPath`/`PureWindowsPath`: path arithmetic on text with fixed separator rules and no file-system access.
Joins path segments like `os.path.join`: an absolute segment discards everything before it.
Returns the absolute path with `..` removed and symbolic links followed.
True when a path lies under another one, compared by parts; meaningful only on resolved paths.
Untrusted names such as `../x` or absolute paths that escape the directory they were meant to stay in.
An in-memory binary file object; `read(n)` returns at most `n` bytes and `b""` at the end.
